title: Mona Draft League I
description: A draft-style challenge where each team is built around one of three role archetypes.
highlights: Three separate Pokémon tables for offensive, defensive, and mixed picks;
Each row includes a checkbox to mark a Pokémon as unavailable for drafting;
The draft roster is grouped to reflect balanced team-building priorities.
overview: Mona Draft League is a structured draft format for building a team around a mix of pressure, stability, and flexibility. The tables below are meant to help track which Pokémon are still available or already locked out for a draft pick.

clauses.title: Draft Availability
clauses.body: Use the checkbox beside each Pokémon to mark it unavailable when a pick is no longer legal or has already been drafted.

clauses.title: Role Split
clauses.body: Offensive picks are meant to pressure the opponent quickly, defensive picks are meant to absorb pressure and hold a position, and mixed picks give a flexible middle ground.
